notes:
ブラウス (from English "blouse") refers to a woman's or girl's lightweight top, typically worn as part of formal or business attire.

Common types:
- ⟦{長袖|ながそで}→長袖：15517_nagasode⟧ブラウス (long-sleeved blouse)
- ⟦{半袖|はんそで}→半袖：15518_hansode⟧ブラウス (short-sleeved blouse)
- ⟦シフォン→シフォン：noentry⟧ブラウス (chiffon blouse)
- ⟦フリル→フリル：noentry⟧ブラウス (ruffled blouse)

Related terms:
- ⟦ワイシャツ→ワイシャツ：01068_waishatsu⟧ (dress shirt - typically men's)
- ⟦カットソー→カットソー：28534_kattosoo⟧ (knit top)

Note: In school uniforms, girls often wear ブラウス while boys wear ⟦ワイシャツ→ワイシャツ：01068_waishatsu⟧.
